rawAnnotationMemberships.meaning: Nonexclusive memberships of removed source cells in original supplied masks. Counts may overlap and must not be summed as removed volume. Raw brain/target overlap is unreviewed annotation overlap, not clinical healthy-tissue truth. These counts do not change the OWNED target denominator.

directProtectionMaskTargetMembership.meaning: Union of original OWNED target identities directly inside the exact supplied protection masks. Per-structure counts overlap. This does not change the original target denominator or establish swept-tool clearance, reachability, or that all legal approaches were exhausted. The 2 mm guard clearance is separate.
